utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Vik, I’ve got screws covered already, but we still need duct tape and a couple pairs of work gloves for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Got it, Cleo—I’ll tell folks screws are covered and that what we need now is duct tape and a couple pairs of work gloves for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Perfect, Vik—that keeps the list straight, and if anyone commits, send them my way so I can mark it down.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, that’s still my understanding—around 10, and I think they’re mostly looking for supplies like duct tape and a couple pairs of work gloves, but we should probably confirm before spreading it around.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That matches what I’d heard second-hand too—money for parts and loaned tools, but I’m still not totally sure. We should probably check with Rosa before we pass anything along.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, Rosa would know for sure—I’m half-remembering supplies, so let’s check with her before we tell anyone else.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Leo, quick version: Saturday at the church lot, and I’m bringing a drill, extension cord, and spare screws. If you’ve got the latest repair list, send it over and I’ll skim who needs tools versus fixes.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Got it—Saturday at the church lot. I don’t have the latest list yet, but I’ll check with Mara or Rosa and send it over; duct tape and work gloves still need covering too.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Perfect—check Rosa first and send me whatever you get. I’ve got my drill stuff covered, but duct tape and gloves still need a volunteer.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Happy to help with the repair drive—what still needs doing, and should I start with outreach or supplies?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Best to start with supplies so it stays clear—we still need duct tape and two pairs of work gloves, and then we can do outreach once that’s tracked.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Got it—I’ll pick up duct tape and two pairs of work gloves first, then I can help with outreach once that’s covered.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Hana—I’m still out on errands, but keep me posted on how the repair drive’s shaping up and who else is in.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Sure—I’ll keep you posted, but before I lock anything in, can you confirm the latest sign-up count and whether the Patel house is already marked finished?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’m still out on errands and don’t have the sheet in front of me, so don’t lock that in yet—can you check the latest count and whether the Patel house is already marked finished, then send me the update?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can do around 10 if that’s still the plan, but I need to keep it pretty tight around school pickup and drop-off. Have you heard any clearer details from the organizer yet?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Not really—details are still fuzzy, so can you confirm if you’re actually in for 10 and what tools, if any, you can bring?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Yes, I’m in for 10 as long as we keep it fairly tight, and I can bring a basic toolkit and a couple of screwdrivers. If you hear anything firmer from the organizer, let me know so I can plan around pickup.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I’m late, Opal—what’s the first thing that still needs a hand for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: First thing is checking which Maple houses still need coverage—we’ve already got 12, 18, and 27 on the list, so I’m tracking the rest.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it—I'll start checking which Maple houses still need coverage and report back on any gaps.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Good to hear it’s coming together — I’ll still bring my toolbox and spare clamps, and it sounds like duct tape and a couple pairs of work gloves are the main things left.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: That helps, Gus, but has anyone actually confirmed the full volunteer list and which houses are definitely first on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Not that I’ve heard yet — last solid update was still that folks were sorting the parts list, so confirming volunteers and the first houses sounds like the next thing to lock down.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Jules, I’m spreading the word fast for the repair drive—can I count you in, and should I let the others know you’re on board too?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely—I’m in, and you can let folks know I’m helping coordinate; right now it’s looking like around 10, and we still need duct tape plus a couple pairs of work gloves.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect, I’ll let everyone know you’re helping coordinate around 10, and I’ll spread the word that we still need duct tape and a couple pairs of work gloves.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’m still on it—I’ll keep gathering volunteers and repair items, and I’ll send Rosa the updated list with the duct tape and two pairs of work gloves.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That’s perfect, Mara—duct tape and two pairs of work gloves are still the main gaps, so sending Rosa the updated list really helps. I’ll keep telling folks we’re moving ahead and still taking volunteers.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Great—I’ll send Rosa that update now and keep asking around for a few more volunteers in case anyone else can pitch in.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Rosa, sorry, I’m a little scrambled—I've got the folding tables, lamp rewiring still needs someone, and I still need to bring Uli those spare screws this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Oren—that helps a lot. Just remember the repair drive’s Sunday at the community center, and lamp rewiring still needs someone while we’re still short on duct tape and a couple pairs of work gloves.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, thank you, Rosa—I’d forgotten the duct tape and gloves part too. I’ve still got the folding tables and Uli’s screws on my end, and we’re still missing someone for the lamp rewiring.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’ve got the list written down: folding tables are Oren’s, lamp rewiring’s still unclaimed, and we still need duct tape and two pairs of work gloves. If you want, we can go through the jobs one at a time.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Yeah, thanks — one at a time would help. Let’s start with the unclaimed rewiring, then make sure the duct tape and gloves are covered.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Okay… lamp rewiring is still open, then after that we need duct tape and two pairs of work gloves. If you want, we can see who feels comfortable taking the lamp first.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yep, that’s still the latest, Rosa—duct tape and two pairs of work gloves are the big needs, and I’m telling folks Uli’s tools are still tentative until he confirms.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect, Tess—thanks for keeping that message consistent; please keep flagging duct tape and two pairs of work gloves as our main gaps, and I’ll follow up on Uli’s tools separately.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: You got it, Rosa—I’ll keep spreading the word that duct tape and two pairs of work gloves are the main gaps for Sunday, and I’ll leave Uli’s tools as tentative until you hear back.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Quinn, keep it simple for now: tell folks they can bring things that need fixing, and that we still need duct tape and two pairs of work gloves.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Got it—I’ll spread that it’s a repair drive, folks can bring things that need fixing, and we still need duct tape plus two pairs of work gloves.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That’s right, Quinn. Let’s stick to just that until we’ve confirmed the rest, so nobody gets crossed up.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’ve only heard second-hand that they’re collecting money for parts and borrowing tools, but I still don’t know who’s definitely committed. Rosa’s pulling the list together, so we should confirm with her before we count anyone in.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I’m coming in late, Nell—once Rosa confirms the list, what’s the first thing that still needs a hand for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Probably checking who’s actually bringing tools versus just maybe bringing them—I’ve only heard bits and pieces, so Rosa’s the one who can really pin that down.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: How’s the repair drive shaping up, Cleo? I’m still out on errands, so keep me posted on what’s left.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: It’s coming along — I’ve got screws covered, but we still need duct tape and a couple pairs of work gloves for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Cleo—that helps. I’m still out on errands, but keep me posted if anyone picks up the duct tape and work gloves for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: It’s coming together, slowly. More steady hands would help most right now, and I think we still need gloves and a bit of tape.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I can pull a few more steady hands in from my side of the block, and Noah had 10 in mind and mentioned duct tape plus a couple pairs of work gloves were still needed.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: That’d help, thanks. Ten sounds about right, and yes—duct tape and a couple pairs of work gloves would still be useful.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Sam, what’s still not assigned for the repair drive, and who’s actually confirmed to cover each job?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: From what I know, Quinn’s covering outreach and scheduling, Cleo’s handling supplies, and the big gaps are still recruiting more bike and small-appliance folks plus a few practical supply pickups.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Sam, who’s confirmed for those bike and small-appliance spots, and who’s actually taking the supply pickups?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can make 10 work for the repair drive if we keep it pretty tight around school pickup and drop-off—have you heard anything more from the organizer yet?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, Jules says it’s coming together nicely—they’ve got a few tool people lined up, and I’m telling folks we mainly need more steady hands now. I’ll keep you posted as I hear more.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That helps, thanks—I can still do 10, just as long as we keep it wrapped up in time for school pickup.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Leo, before we lock anything in, can you check with the organizers on the latest sign-up count, which houses still need fixes, and a firm drop-off window?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yep—I’ll check with Mara or Rosa and send you the sign-up count, repair list, and drop-off window once I have it.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Leo — I just don’t want us promising coverage or having people show up with tools at random before those details are confirmed.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: I’m pretty sure we’re still aiming for around 10, and I think duct tape plus a couple pairs of work gloves are the main things still needed.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Can you confirm who’s definitely committed so far, then, and whether you’re actually in by 10 or still just thinking around then? If that’s settled, I can ask around for duct tape and work gloves.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Uh, I’m still just thinking around 10 myself, not locked in yet, and I’m not totally sure who’s definitely committed besides folks helping organize. But yeah, if you ask around for duct tape and a couple pairs of work gloves, that’d help.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Mara, on Maple I’ve got 12, 18, and 27 already on the repair drive list, and I’m still tracking the rest of Maple plus the corner apartments so nothing slips through.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Opal—that really helps. I’ll send Rosa Maple’s current list and keep gathering any volunteers, plus duct tape and two pairs of work gloves, while you finish tracking the rest.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Perfect—keep me posted if Rosa finds any additions, and I’ll keep tracking the rest of Maple and the corner apartments from my notes.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’ve got it simple for now: Maple porch steps first, then the garden lot fence, and lamp rewiring is still unclaimed. If you can match your tools and spare clamps to that, I’ll add it to the list.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Perfect — I’ll bring my toolbox and spare clamps for the porch steps and fence, and I can at least help with the lamp rewiring if nobody else claims it.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That helps, Gus. I’ll note your toolbox and clamps for the steps and fence, and mark you as backup on the lamp rewiring unless someone takes it.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Hey Oren — quick version, I’m bringing the drill, extension cord, and spare screws; do you have the latest list of fixes and who’s covering tools?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh—thanks, Bo, that helps a ton. Last I remember, I’m fixing the folding tables, the lamp rewiring still needed a volunteer, and I was supposed to get spare screws over to Uli, though it sounds like you’ve got screws covered too.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Perfect—mark screws covered on my end, and if the lamp rewiring still needs someone, send me the latest list so I can help fill that gap fast.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Quinn, I’m still gathering names and repair needs, and I already promised Rosa the priority order plus duct tape and two pairs of work gloves. If you’ve got anything else to add, I’ll send it her way too.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great, Mara—please add that I’m spreading invitations fast and lining up more helpers, and let Rosa know Sam’s in and helping spread the word too.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Perfect—I’ll add that you and Sam are helping spread the word and line up more hands, and I’ll send it all over to Rosa with the rest of the list.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I’ll grab the duct tape and two pairs of work gloves, medium and large, and bring them by.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Perfect, Leo—that covers the last supplies on my list, so I’ll mark duct tape and the gloves as handled for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great, I’ll drop them off by the shed later today.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Okay—before we send anyone out, can you check with Rosa or Hana on the sign-up count and which houses still need fixes? Once that’s clear, I can follow the list and help where I’m pointed.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Yes, that’s the safest way to do it — I’ll check with Rosa or Hana first so we know the sign-up count and which houses still need fixes, then I’ll bring you a clear list.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Pia — once you have the list, just show me where to start and what tools to bring.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh—right, Ira, I’ve got the folding tables, and I still need to bring Uli those spare screws this afternoon. I think lamp rewiring still needs someone unless that changed.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Oren—that helps. I’m still out on errands, so keep me posted once Uli has the screws, and let me know if anyone picks up the lamp rewiring.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Will do, Ira—I’m sorry, I nearly let that slip again, but I’ll tell you once Uli has the screws and if someone takes the lamp rewiring.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Gus, the latest I’ve got is that screws are covered now, but we still need duct tape and a couple pairs of work gloves. Uli said they can bring a few tools later, and I’m still waiting on that full list you mentioned.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Good to know—I've got my toolbox and clamps ready, and if the list's still slow coming in, I can at least scrounge up some duct tape before the drive.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That’d help a lot, Gus—if you can grab duct tape, that leaves us mostly chasing the work gloves while I keep after that full list.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Kira, what’s actually confirmed for Sunday—how many sign-ups do we have now, and who’s definitely covering tools and repairs?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: I’d want Rosa or Sam to confirm that firsthand, Mina—last I heard Bo was reviewing tools and repair needs, and Mara was still gathering volunteer names this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Then who’s actually locking this down, Kira—can you get Rosa or Sam to confirm the current sign-up count and exactly who’s covering tools and repair jobs?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Hana, the simple version is folks can bring things that need fixing, and we still need duct tape plus two pairs of work gloves for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Eli — before I lock anything in, can you confirm the latest sign-up count and which houses still need fixes?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I can’t confirm a sign-up count or which houses still need fixes yet, Hana—I’ve only got the simple drive details. Best plan is to check with Vik for the latest list, and for now keep sharing that folks can bring repairs plus we still need duct tape and two pairs of work gloves.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Uli — thanks again; I’ve got your tools noted as tentative for now, and we still need duct tape plus two pairs of work gloves for Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Rosa — that matches what I’ve got too, and I’m still hoping a few more steady hands come through by Sunday.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Uli — I’ll keep checking on volunteers and supplies, and I’ll let everyone know as soon as the tools are fully confirmed.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: I’m still thinking around 10 for the repair drive, and I think duct tape plus a couple pairs of work gloves are what we still need—unless I’m mixing anything up.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That matches what I’ve got too, Noah—around 10 for now, and duct tape plus a couple pairs of work gloves still needed. I’ll keep telling folks it’s not fully locked in yet and keep pulling people together.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, good—thanks, Jules. Yeah, let’s keep saying around 10 for now, and I think it’s still just duct tape and a couple pairs of work gloves unless I’m forgetting something.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I only heard second-hand that they’re collecting money for parts and loaned tools, but I’m still not sure who’s definitely bringing what. Can you confirm what Sam’s heard before we count on it?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: From what I’ve heard, Cleo’s sorting supplies and Quinn’s handling outreach and scheduling, but I’d still want to confirm who’s definitely bringing tools and parts before we count on it.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That matches what I’d heard—money for parts and some loaned tools, but not a firm tool list yet. We should probably confirm with Rosa or the organizer before anyone treats it as settled.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Opal, quick version: I’ve got the drill, extension cord, and spare screws covered, but I’m still waiting on Rosa’s list before I can sort who needs what fixed.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Good, that helps—on Maple I’ve already got 12, 18, and 27 covered, and I’m tracking the rest of Maple plus the corner apartments while we wait on Rosa’s list.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Perfect—that gives us a decent start. Keep tracking Maple and the corner apartments, and once Rosa sends the list I’ll match up the tool needs fast.
